text: She, following her guru’s instruction, brought to her face the fragrant smoke of the shy incense. The flame, creeping along her cheek, momentarily turned her earlobes the color of lotuses. Her bride’s face, with its slightly moist, reddened cheek-lines and eyes darkened by the soot of her sighs, became adorned with a garland of fatigue, as she held the smoke of the ritual.
